versions.name: J. Warren Cutler Scout Reservation

features.note: Three-sided lean-tos with overhanging roofs, each with a tent area around it.
The range is run most weekends by the campmaster crew.
The range can be run by unit-provided trained instructors or by camp staff when available.
Lodges and heated buildings with wood-burning stoves, including a three-bedroom lodge with kitchen and a bunkroom sleeping twenty-four.
On the camp's own fishing lake.
An office, exam room, patient resting room and private bathroom for medical staff.
An extensive system of hiking trails across more than fourteen hundred acres.
A nature lodge with taxidermy mounts of local mammals, birds and fish plus plant and tree displays.
Permanent orienteering courses on the property.
Use requires a certified rifle instructor and a range safety officer.
Cub campers stay in five themed villages: tall ships and a lighthouse, an old west fort, a medieval castle, a mountain man encampment and a native village.
Facilities are available year-round, including heated buildings with wood stoves.

versions.summary: Cub Scout overnight resident adventure camp operated by Seneca Waterways Council in Naples, New York.
